stories.body: A new package is tabled in the early hours; President Kurum says it is a text all parties can agree on. Approval at 06:00 GMT.
stories.headline: COP31 closes in on a deal on day 14

stories.body: The Guards say missile and drone strikes hit US Patriot radars at the al-Riffa and Awali bases. Bahrain says a civilian site was hit, with no injuries.
stories.headline: Iran's Guards claim hits on two US bases in Bahrain

stories.body: The 6.7 quake struck Friday at 7:09 pm local time, 30 km north-west of Junín, and was felt in Lima. Civil defence counts 1 dead, 16 hurt and 152 homes uninhabitable.
stories.headline: Peru counts the cost of its 6.7 quake

stories.body: More than 400 drones and 110 missiles — 27 of them ballistic, some with cluster warheads — hit energy, rail and water targets overnight into Friday. Eight people were killed, six in Kyiv and two in Lviv, and about 30 were hurt. Three bridges over the Dnipro were struck and power and water cut in parts of the capital.
stories.headline: Russia's 400-drone barrage: Kyiv counts the damage

stories.body: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, wanted by the FBI with a $5m reward, was taken on Friday night in Guasave. Eleven people were killed in the raid — four soldiers and seven gunmen. US intelligence helped; he was flown to Mexico City.
stories.headline: Mexico seizes 'El Chapo Isidro' in a night raid

stories.body: Warsaw calls it a provocation after two Russian missiles and a drone came down on its soil during the barrage. NATO's chief calls it a grave violation as allies weigh a response.
stories.headline: Russian missiles and a drone crash into Poland

stories.body: Drones struck a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland; Helsinki tightens security around its ports. Prime Minister Orpo says the war in Ukraine is spilling into Finland's neighbourhood.
stories.headline: Drones hit a Russian cargo ship in the Baltic

stories.body: Kimi Antonelli was fastest in the desert night, but a five-place grid penalty hands pole to Verstappen, with Russell alongside. The race runs on Sunday under the Las Vegas lights.
stories.headline: Verstappen on pole in Vegas

stories.body: The 6.8 quake struck deep under the Banda Sea on Saturday evening, 105 km north-east of Lospalos, and was felt in Darwin and Katherine. Geoscience Australia took more than 1,600 felt reports. No damage, no tsunami.
stories.headline: M6.8 quake shakes the Banda Sea, felt in Darwin

stories.body: Bitcoin trades near $60,200 on Sunday, up about 2% in 24 hours, after Saturday's plunge to $55,130 — its lowest since September 2024. November is still down about 23% from $77,435 at the end of October.
stories.headline: Bitcoin climbs back above $60,000

stories.body: Defence Minister Richard Marles hit back on Sunday at a US budget-office report saying AUKUS would cut the attack submarines available to the US Navy. US-commanded Virginia-class boats arrive in Australia from next year.
stories.headline: Australia hits back at the US budget office over AUKUS

stories.body: After a decade of talks, the EU and Indonesia sign a deal that wipes out 98.5% of tariffs between Brussels and South-East Asia's largest economy.
stories.headline: EU and Indonesia sign a trade deal a decade in the making

stories.body: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its national crime database. The scale of the intrusion is still unclear, US media report.
stories.headline: FBI probes a breach of its crime database

stories.body: El Niño-driven drought is at crisis levels across Fiji and Tonga, while Tropical Cyclone Xavier fades over open water north of Samoa.
stories.headline: El Niño drought hits crisis levels in Fiji and Tonga

stories.body: Talks in Geneva on lethal autonomous weapons end below calls for enforceable guidelines, despite 128 countries agreeing to work toward rules.
stories.headline: UN talks on killer robots fall short of binding rules

stories.body: The platform launches a detection tool for public figures worldwide as it tries to curb AI-made disinformation ahead of European elections next year.
stories.headline: TikTok rolls out a deepfake-spotting tool worldwide

stories.body: Trump, Putin and Xi met in Shenzhen on Thursday and billed themselves as a force for peace. Ukraine's allies meet in Berlin to read the signals; Europe says it is ready for talks with Russia.
stories.headline: Trump, Putin and Xi's Shenzhen talks: the world reads the signals

stories.body: Copenhagen expels Moscow's defence attaché over a foiled plot against a Ukrainian rapper.
stories.headline: Denmark expels Russia's defence attaché

stories.body: The Commission was targeted in a cyberattack, according to a report; the scale is not yet public.
stories.headline: EU Commission hit in cyberattack, report says

stories.body: Tokyo and New Delhi agree deeper military and defence-industry ties, including live-fire missile training by Japanese troops at Indian ranges.
stories.headline: Japan and India deepen defence ties

stories.body: Satellite images seen by AFP show Beijing building a runway on another island in the disputed waterway.
stories.headline: China builds a new runway on a South China Sea island

stories.body: A magnitude 4.1 quake struck Myanmar in the early hours of Sunday, the National Centre for Seismology says.
stories.headline: M4.1 quake rattles Myanmar early Sunday

stories.body: About 5,700 voters begin choosing the powerful Election Committee in Hong Kong.
stories.headline: Hong Kong votes for its Election Committee

stories.body: Toxic alcohol kills 11 people and sickens 180 in the north-eastern Indian state.
stories.headline: Toxic alcohol kills 11 and sickens 180 in Manipur

stories.body: US Central Command says no American fighter was attacked at all, after Tehran claimed a missile damaged an F-16 over the Gulf.
stories.headline: US denies Iran hit an F-16 over the Gulf

stories.body: Three tankers were hit near the Strait of Hormuz as Tehran readies 14 tankers to test the US naval blockade of its ports.
stories.headline: Three tankers hit near the Strait of Hormuz

stories.body: Yashar party chairman Gadi Eisenkot opens intensive coalition talks with Likud, with a first meeting set.
stories.headline: Eisenkot invites Netanyahu's Likud to coalition talks

stories.body: The Tasis Alliance seizes the Bau region in Blue Nile, a key gain in Sudan's civil war.
stories.headline: Sudan's Tasis Alliance seizes Bau in Blue Nile

stories.body: Ethiopia will host the next climate summit, COP32, in November 2027.
stories.headline: Next climate summit heads to Addis Ababa

stories.body: A man is convicted of starting the Los Angeles fire that burned through the Palisades.
stories.headline: Man convicted of starting the Palisades fire

stories.body: The president threatens to stop American companies building AI data centres overseas.
stories.headline: Trump threatens a ban on US firms building AI data centres abroad

stories.body: Carriers are warned of possible al-Qaeda-linked attacks ahead of the Thanksgiving travel rush.
stories.headline: US airlines warned of possible al-Qaeda-linked attacks

stories.body: More than 1,000 emergency staff are told to work from home after the Washington office is found infested with bed bugs.
stories.headline: Bed bugs shut FEMA's Washington office

stories.body: Brazil's jailed former president is in intensive care with an acute bowel obstruction.
stories.headline: Bolsonaro in intensive care with a bowel obstruction

stories.body: Three Salvadorans are killed handling explosives in Haiti — the first official deaths after deployment.
stories.headline: Three Salvadorans killed handling explosives in Haiti
